scope: Review-only job 2: all 214 assigned changed server-mode pairs from the frozen earlier matrix; no new captures or live interaction checks. Candidate identity follows the existing matrix record.
crop_method: Per-channel pixel difference threshold 16; bounding box plus 40 pixels of context clipped to source bounds. Native unless crop exceeds 780 pixels wide, then reduced to 780. Main left, candidate right; at most two distinct pairs per image. Selected wide pairs also have native text insets.
coverage_limits: Existing still images only; no new captures, browser suites, mutation runs or code changes.
Git-remotes pair 1858 contains table headers only on both sides.
Query-composer and some property-edit/search/team filenames do not establish the named open state.
Traffic, imported items and unpublished-change behavior are not comprehensively established by this assigned subset.
Downscaled comparisons are identified per pair; native insets cover selected text regions rather than every text region of a wide screen.
